script: The deepest fish ever filmed was swimming more than 8 kilometers down. It was a snailfish, recorded in 2022 in a trench off Japan at about 8,300 meters. Snailfish like this have soft, jelly-like bodies with no scales. The pressure down there is about 800 times greater than at the surface. Scientists think fish probably cannot survive much deeper than about 8,400 meters. Below that, the deepest trenches belong to animals like shrimp-like amphipods.
